# The California Evidence-Based Clearinghouse for Child Welfare

> A comprehensive registry and resource center for evidence-based programs and practices in child welfare, foster care, and family support services.

CEBC provides California child welfare professionals with access to rigorously reviewed and scientifically rated programs, implementation guidance, and training resources. The clearinghouse evaluates interventions across multiple topic areas including parenting support, trauma treatment, foster care services, and housing assistance.

## Key Topics

- Evidence-Based Practices
- Child Welfare
- Foster Care
- Program Registry
- Scientific Rating Scales
- Implementation Guidance
- Parenting Programs
- Trauma-Informed Interventions

- Measurement Tools
- Foster Care Youth Support

## Program Discovery & Registry

- [Programs](https://www.cebc4cw.org/programs): Searchable directory of evidence-based programs for child welfare.
- [The California Evidence-Based Clearinghouse for Child Welfare](https://www.cebc4cw.org): CEBC homepage with program registry and evidence-based practices.
- [Program Topics](https://www.cebc4cw.org/topic-areas): Topic directory covering behavioral interventions and child welfare areas.

## Featured Evidence-Based Programs

- [Child-Parent Psychotherapy](https://www.cebc4cw.org/program/child-parent-psychotherapy): Early childhood mental health intervention for trauma and attachment.
- [Trauma Systems Therapy–Foster Care](https://www.cebc4cw.org/program/trauma-systems-therapy-foster-care): TST-FC program for trauma-informed foster care intervention.
- [Triple P – Positive Parenting Program® – Level 2 Selected Seminar Series](https://www.cebc4cw.org/program/triple-p-positive-parenting-program-level-2-selected-seminar-series): Triple P parenting program Level 2 seminars and rating.
- [Resource Parent Curriculum](https://www.cebc4cw.org/program/resource-parent-curriculum): Trauma-informed training for resource and adoptive parents.
- [Visit Coaching/Family Time Coaching](https://www.cebc4cw.org/program/visit-coaching): Family visitation coaching program for reunification support.
- [Housing and Supportive Housing Interventions](https://www.cebc4cw.org/topic-area/housing-and-supportive-housing-interventions): Evidence-based housing interventions for foster care youth.

## Implementation & Training

- [Implementation](https://www.cebc4cw.org/implementation): Implementation guidance and tools for evidence-based practices.
- [CEBC Webinars](https://www.cebc4cw.org/cebc-webinars): Professional development webinars and training calendar.
- [Tools And Resources](https://www.cebc4cw.org/tools-resources): Measurement tools, technical assistance, and training resources.

## Rating Methodology & Reference

- [CEBC Review and Rating Process](https://www.cebc4cw.org/registry/cebc-review-and-rating-process): CEBC methodology for program review and scientific rating.
- [Rating Scales](https://www.cebc4cw.org/ratings): Scientific rating scales and measurement tools for assessment.
- [Glossary](https://www.cebc4cw.org/glossary): Definitions of evidence-based practice and child welfare terminology.

## Getting Started & Support

- [Using the CEBC](https://www.cebc4cw.org/using-cebc): User guides and navigation help for CEBC website and resources.
- [About Us](https://www.cebc4cw.org/about): CEBC organization overview, staff, and leadership information.
